purpose: library: the Köppen-Geiger climate classification as comparable categories — climate as the reoccurring average weather measured over 30-year intervals; Wladimir Köppen (1846-1940) dividing world climates by temperature profile related to latitude, modified with Rudolf Geiger; A tropical (all months averaging above 64°F (18°C), annual precipitation above 59 inches, 15°-25° latitude), B dry (potential evaporation and transpiration exceeding precipitation, 20°-35° latitudes and continental mid-latitudes), C moist subtropical mid-latitude (30°-50°, warm humid summers, mild winters, mid-latitude cyclones), D moist continental mid-latitude (warm to cool summers, cold winters), E polar (warmest month below 50°F (10°C)) and H highlands (elevation-driven). Fits a compare table of zone × criteria × location, quiz cards with predict-then-reveal on the temperature and precipitation thresholds and latitude bands, and a concept map.
